Significantly reduced home size and advanced energy-saving building techniques like airtight homes, vacuum insulation panels, and ground-source/ground-air heat exchangers and heat recovery ventilators dramatically reduce required building materials and energy use.

Better recycling for packaging and used goods does not necessarily require advanced technology, just a better economic framework.

Mobile-type more efficient computers can cut energy use by huge factors.
